# U152: Metric links carry over: as Amara, on 21 Dec 2026 Start 2027 on Cycles; every goal carried into 2027 that was measured by a metric in 2026 is measured by the same metric, for the same team and part, in 2027

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRICS-MEASURED-BY`
- **Budget:** 4 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `budget`, `progress`, `errors` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U152

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page’s lead shows.
- _Note:_ The example copied into a workspace of Amara's own, so it keeps 2026 when the clock moves (as U115 does).
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `async () => { const full = await window.__goalsStore.load('platform-org'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:workspaces', JSON.stringify([{ id: 'ws_links', name: 'Links turn', kind: 'own', createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' }])); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-v2:ws_links', JSON.stringify({ ...full })); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-workspace', 'ws_links'); localStorage.setItem('goals-app-viewer:ws_links', 'amara'); }`.
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo on Monday 21 December 2026.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Start 2027” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” link.
- **Check:** “Everyone stays in 2026 until Sun 3 Jan 2027” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “read-back”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Start 2027” button.
- **Check:** “2027 is ready” is shown.
- _Note:_ A carried goal keeps its key (G-1, G-2 …): its link is the 2026 goal's with the same key, carried.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `from.length > 0 && same`, where `const s = await h.snapshot('ws_links')`; `const y27 = s.cycles.find((c) => c.name === '2027' && !c.removedAt)`; `const links = ((s.modules || {}).metrics || {}).metricLinks || []`; `const live = (l) => !l.removedAt`; `const was26 = new Map(s.goals.filter((g) => g.cycleId !== y27.id && g.key).map((g) => [g.key, g]))`; `const carried = s.goals.filter((g) => g.cycleId === y27.id && g.key && was26.has(g.key))`; `const from = carried.map((g) => ({ g, was: links.find((l) => live(l) && l.goalId === was26.get(g.key).id), now: links.find((l) => live(l) && l.goalId === g.id) })).filter((x) => x.was)`; `const same = from.every((x) => x.now && x.now.metricId === x.was.metricId && (x.now.teamId || '') === (x.was.teamId || '') && (x.now.part || '') === (x.was.part || ''))`. Else it says: of {from.length} carried goals measured by a metric, {from.filter((x) => !x.now).length} came without their link and {worked out in the journey as `from.filter((x) => x.now && x.now.metricId !== x.was.metricId).length`} with another metric.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `Boolean(y27)`, where `const s = await h.snapshot('ws_links')`; `const y27 = s.cycles.find((c) => c.name === '2027' && !c.removedAt)`. Else it says: 2027 did not start.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'cycle' && c.summary.startsWith('Started 2027'))`, where `const s = await h.snapshot('ws_links')`. Else it says: starting 2027 was not logged.
- Close this browser.
